attempts.summary: Built a three-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (AlmaLinux 9), running as systemd services with static bootstrap (initial-cluster listing all three peer URLs on port 2380, client traffic on 2379), SELinux context set for the binaries, and firewalld opened for 2379/2380. Verified a key written on node1 is readable from node2 and node3. Demonstrated availability during a member outage: stopped etcd on node3, wrote/read a new key via node1/node2 while node3 was down, then restarted node3 and confirmed it caught up on the missed key with matching raft-applied-index across all members. Finally executed the mandatory one-at-a-time OS reboot protocol on all three nodes: captured boot_id and etcd/data health before each reboot, triggered a native `reboot`, polled until the node was reachable again, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified etcd/cluster quorum/stored keys were healthy before moving to the next node.
